Projects & Modifications: Provide HVAC engineering support for new projects, facility expansions, equipment installation, and system modifications, ensuring technical and GMP requirements are met. Energy Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve HVAC energy efficiency, system performance, and operating costs without compromising GMP requirements. Qualifications & Requirements 5–8 years of relevant experience in HVAC engineering and maintenance, preferably within pharmaceutical, healthcare, food, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
